LyricsX - Lyrics for iTunes, Spotify and Vox.

summary.one_liner: LyricsX is a macOS app that automatically finds, downloads, and displays synced lyrics for music playing in your music player.
summary.what_it_does: LyricsX shows lyrics on the desktop and in the menu bar while a song plays, and works with several music players. It automatically searches for and downloads lyrics from multiple sources. Users can customize the font, color, and position of the lyrics display. The status menu offers a lyrics offset adjustment, and double-clicking a line jumps playback to that position. It supports drag-and-drop import and export of lyrics files, can auto-launch and quit with the music player, and converts between Traditional and Simplified Chinese. It uses its own LRCX lyrics format, which adds word time tags and multi-language translation and is compatible with LRC.
use_cases: show synced lyrics while listening to music on a Mac
display lyrics in the menu bar or on the desktop
automatically download lyrics for songs in my library
edit or time lyrics files in LRC or LRCX format
convert Chinese lyrics between Traditional and Simplified
karaoke-style lyrics for music playing on macOS
how_to_run: Or download the app from the project's releases page (manual install)
notable: Automatic live lyrics search and download from multiple lyrics sources
Custom LRCX lyrics format with word time tags and multi-language translation, compatible with LRC
Double-click a lyrics line to jump playback to that position
Lyrics shown on desktop and menu bar with adjustable offset
caveats: iOS app and lyricsx-cli for Linux are described as in early development
No official LRCX editor yet; the README points to a third-party tool, Lrcx_Creator
Mac App Store install option is listed without instructions
